contract.title: Adversarial review of revised E0 calibration design
contract.goal: Review the exact-main implementation surfaces and identify blocking flaws in this proposed design: pre-scan feasibility must compare load multiplier, physically interpretable ISL capacity scaling, and a separate long-distance corridor stress scenario; fixed observation and drain audits must be separated; vis_k=17 is only a full-graph-reach cache reference and needs cache coverage/age/TTL/field integrity evidence; ISL pressure must be hierarchical per-link-over-time then across exposed links; seed 7 is not enough at a boundary, with two-seed boundary confirmation and three-seed final confirmation; define scenario-invariant SHA and cell-plan SHA separately; all VM cells must use the canonical deploy/authorize/run-remote/status/receipt chain; governance changes must be a separate exact-SHA cold-reviewed PR. Attack feasibility math, false pairing, semantic drift, artifact gaps, and unrealistic claims. Return concise FACT/INFERENCE/open_items with exact GitHub line references.
acceptance: Every blocking finding cites exact GitHub lines
Separates measurement-proxy baseline from controlled pressure scenarios
Checks that adaptive cells can use the existing canonical launcher without dynamic uncommitted configs
Does not claim pressure will be found or that three seeds support significance
requiredEvidence: At least two independent exact-line evidence anchors
A final verdict PASS or REQUEST_CHANGES
